I could not verify Google Business Profile claim status for any business; 'findable' scores reflect the completeness of listing information seen on mirrors, not ownership.
Page titles returned by the browser included a stray emoji prefix on several sites; I recorded the text portion of the titles only.

LuminEssence appears to be a service line of New Image Hair Salon at the same address and phone rather than a standalone shop - that grouping is my inference from matching address/phone and the shared service page.
